With a power density of 1.35 W/cm³, this slim three-port USB-C charger delivers up to 160W. It is as compact as an AirPods Pro 3 case and easy to carry.
A single port delivers up to 140W without throttling, so laptops charge at full speed. Whichever port you use, a 16-inch MacBook Pro goes from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes.
Smart power distribution with PowerIQ 5.0 charges a 16-inch MacBook Pro, an iPhone 16 Pro Max and an 11-inch iPad Pro at the same time, as efficiently as three original chargers (140W + 35W + 35W).
With AnkerSense View you can monitor performance in real time on the display, switch modes instantly and activate individual modes from the app over Bluetooth.
